name: Kwadwo Appiah-Kubi
bio: Associate Professor of Physical Therapy at Clarkson (tenured), with courtesy appointments in Biology and at the University of Health and Allied Sciences in Ghana. He joined Clarkson in 2020 from the University of Ghana, where he taught physical therapy and practiced at Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital. His research focuses on vestibular rehabilitation and postural control using virtual reality — he developed the Gait Sensory Interaction Test (GaitSIT) — and he won an Outstanding Poster Presentation Award at the 2023 World Physiotherapy Congress in Dubai.
